reason: A gives us firm commitments that matter for our decision: offer and decision dates, senior staff choosing shifts first, a six-month window to leave and still get severance, and an HR one-on-one. B leaves placeholders where dates and details should be and gives no such protections, so it reads as unfinished and offers less reason to take the phone role.
